title: Training Notes: Vehicle Registration Upload History and Registration Grace
content:
These notes explain how a Wayfare driver's record of vehicle registration uploads bears on the registration grace days under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product. The registration grace days are the calendar days after a lapsed vehicle registration's expiry date on which the document hold for it begins.

**Rule.** When the standing record holds three or more vehicle registration uploads dated fewer than 36 whole calendar months before the day the grace is worked out, the registration grace days gain 6 days; when it holds exactly two, they gain 4 days; when it holds one or none, they gain none.

| Vehicle registration uploads dated fewer than 36 whole calendar months back | Days gained |
|---|---|
| three or more | 6 |
| exactly two | 4 |
| one or none | 0 |

### Questions answered

**What is counted?** Uploads of the vehicle registration on the standing record, each dated by its upload date. Uploads of other documents are not counted.

**Is the lapsed registration's own upload counted?** Yes, when it is dated within the 36 whole calendar months; every vehicle registration upload in the window counts.

**Hypothetical example.** Grace worked out on 2026-06-01; registration uploads dated 2022-05-10, 2024-05-02 and 2025-05-06. The upload of 2022 is more than 36 whole calendar months back; two uploads count, so the grace gains 4 days.
